definitions.explanation: A machine part that supports a rotating shaft and reduces friction so that it can turn smoothly. The native Japanese term for ベアリング.

examples.japanese: {軸|じく}{受|う}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{摩耗|まもう}→摩耗：14813_mamou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軸|じく}{受|う}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This machine needs its bearings replaced.

examples.japanese: {軸|じく}{受|う}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注油|ちゅうゆ}する→注油する：22365_chuuyusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|なめ}らか→滑らか：06068_nameraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Oiling the bearing makes the rotation smoother.

notes:
The native Japanese term for ⟦ベアリング→ベアリング：29330_bearingu⟧ (from English "bearing"). Common in mechanical engineering and manufacturing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧{軸|じく}{受|う}け: ball bearing
- {軸|じく}{受|う}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: bearing replacement
- {軸|じく}{受|う}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{摩耗|まもう}→摩耗：14813_mamou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the bearing wears out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ベアリング→ベアリング：29330_bearingu⟧: bearing — the more common loanword, used interchangeably in everyday technical speech
